complexity.notes: Membership test against a 3-element list is O(1) but a set or a mapping dict (e.g. {')': '(', ...}) would be more idiomatic and avoid the repeated pop() calls; the current structure calls stack.pop() up to three times per closing bracket, which is awkward though still correct. Worst case is genuinely O(n) since no hash-based structures are used.
complexity.summary: Single pass over the string pushing opening brackets onto a stack; on each closing bracket it pops and verifies the match, returning False on mismatch or empty stack, and finally checks the stack is empty.
